description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ballapanaudabage, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610008
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for specific parcels in Kegalle District. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and property details, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
